summary.text: Ron Fowler is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 31 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Justin Geiser is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ron Fowler earned two bachelor's degrees from the University of Missouri-Kansas City.
His career experience includes more than 40 years at the Lake City Army Ammunition Plant, and he served on the Blue Springs City Council for more than 32 years.
Fowler was assigned to the House Professional Registration and Licensing Committee for 2025-2026.
